design.text: Multicenter, international, randomized (1:1), double-blind, placebo-controlled trial; all patients received vemurafenib and were randomized to cobimetinib or placebo.

citations.quote: The safety and efficacy of cobimetinib was established in a multicenter, randomized (1:1), double-blinded, placebo-controlled trial conducted in 495 patients with previously untreated, BRAF V600 mutation-positive, unresectable or metastatic, melanoma.
Design: randomized (1:1), multicenter, international, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial.
All patients received vemurafenib 960 mg orally twice daily on days 1–8 and were randomized to receive COTELLIC 60 mg or matching placebo orally once daily on days 1–21 of an every 28-day cycle.

population.text: Previously untreated, BRAF V600 mutation-positive unresectable or metastatic melanoma, with mutation detected by the cobas 4800 BRAF V600 mutation test.

citations.quote: Key eligibility criteria were previously untreated, BRAF V600 mutation-positive unresectable or metastatic melanoma. The presence of BRAF V600 mutation was detected using the cobas® 4800 BRAF V600 mutation test.

endpoint.text: Investigator-assessed progression-free survival (PFS) per RECIST v1.1.

citations.quote: Primary endpoint: progression-free survival (PFS) as assessed by clinical investigators using the Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) v1.1.• Key secondary efficacy endpoints were overall survival and best overall response rate (BORR).

n.text: N=495 (247 cobimetinib plus vemurafenib; 248 placebo plus vemurafenib).

citations.quote: The study enrolled 495 patients, of whom 247 patients were randomized to cobimetinib plus vemurafenib and 248 patients were randomized to placebo plus vemurafenib.

result.text: PFS HR 0.56 (95% CI 0.45, 0.70), p<0.001; median PFS 12.3 vs 7.2 months. OS (interim analysis) HR 0.63 (95% CI 0.47, 0.85), p=0.0019 (statistical significance judged against an allocated alpha of 0.019 for this interim analysis), median OS NE vs 17.0 months. ORR 70% vs 50%.

indication.text: COTELLIC is indicated for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma with a BRAF V600E or V600K mutation, in combination with vemurafenib.

citations.quote: COTELLIC is indicated for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma with a BRAF V600E or V600K mutation, in combination with vemurafenib.

target_moa.text: Cobimetinib is a reversible, non-ATP-competitive inhibitor of MEK1 and MEK2, upstream regulators of the ERK pathway which promotes cellular proliferation.

citations.quote: Cobimetinib (Cotellic; Genentech Oncology) is a reversible, non-ATP-competitive inhibitor of the mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK)/extracellular signal regulated kinase 1 (MEK1) and MEK2. These proteins are upstream regulators of the extracellular signal-related kinase (ERK) pathway, which promotes cellular proliferation.
COTELLIC is a kinase inhibitor indicated for the treatment of patients with unresectable or metastatic melanoma with a BRAF V600E or V600K mutation, in combination with vemurafenib. (1, 14)
